messages:
Rafi: Heads up 1: on the dashboard the floating FAB sits over toasts when two notifications are present. Small heights reproduce it. Screenshot in thread.
Neha: Repro'd. Compact table + sticky FAB + bottom-right toasts = collision.
Yuki: Hmm. We tightened vertical rhythm to space-xxs (6px) for density. Toasts still use space-sm (12px). FAB margin is 16px. On short viewports they overlap.
Rafi: We need a fix that doesn't force teams to change their layout. Options: increase toast bottom offset, shift toast anchor, or add FAB-aware offset.
Neha: Prefer a FAB-aware offset. Less surprising than moving anchor. Also keeps toasts predictable for other pages.
Yuki: Proposal: introduce a token `toast-edge-offset` and a modifier `toast-edge-offset--fab` that defaults to 24px. Implementation: toast system reads `document.body.dataset.fab === 'true'` and applies `--toast-edge-offset`.
Rafi: Can we do pure CSS using a custom property fallback? Eg `--toast-edge-offset: calc(var(--fab-gap, 16px) + 8px)`. Then runtime teams can set `--fab-gap` if they change FAB spacing.
Neha: That covers most. But animation: toasts slide in from bottom. If they animate under the FAB visually it looks broken. Need to ensure enter animation respects computed offset and doesn't clip implicitly.
Yuki: Add `transform: translateY(var(--toast-edge-offset))` for final state and use clip-path or overflow visible so motion is clean. Also ensure z-index ordering: toasts should be above FAB visually unless FAB is interactive priority.
Rafi: Accessibility: some toasts are icon-only (no visible text). SRs were silent. We should enforce `aria-live="polite"` and require a visible or an `aria-label` string. Docs should show examples.
Neha: Copy nit for docs: show pattern `aria-label="Info: autosave complete"` and encourage 2-3 word prefix for context. Also mention not to rely on color alone.
design-bot: Token diff suggestion:
```
- --fab-gap: 16px
- --toast-edge-offset: 16px
+ --fab-gap: 16px
+ --toast-edge-offset: calc(var(--fab-gap, 16px) + 8px) /* becomes 24px when FAB present */
```
Yuki: Add a small test: shrink viewport height to 520px with compact rows and verify toasts never overlap FAB and animation doesn't clip.
Rafi: I'll open a tiny PR with token addition, updated CSS var usage, and an example page showing `data-fab` toggle. Neha can meat-check a11y copy.
Neha: Will review. Checklist: visual fix on small heights, aria-live present, icon-only toasts forbidden without aria-label, animation eased and non-clipping, docs updated.
Yuki: I'll add the regression test to console visual tests.
Rafi: Thanks! :sparkles:
